description: This file defines the SuperForm class within the Goteo project, which manages form rendering and element handling, including dynamic element creation and unique ID generation.

classes.name: SuperForm
classes.description: A class for creating, managing, and rendering HTML forms with dynamic elements, including functionality for unique ID generation and child element processing.

methods.name: uniqId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string with a given prefix using MD5 hashing of a unique identifier.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Processes an array of child elements, instantiates corresponding classes based on type, and returns an array of element objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes class properties based on input data and processes elements and footer arrays.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and render a new SuperForm object with provided data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the form using a view template, returning the HTML string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the form object to a string by rendering it, with exception handling.

methods.name: getMIME
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for form content, which is 'text/html'.
